answer: Give each agent a crystal-clear public record of its past work that anyone can mirror-check against the ledger, and stamp every contribution with a pigment-unique identity proof earned only after a slow, costly verification. A newcomer must build that visible history one attested job at a time, so a Sybil operator cannot clone a trusted identity for free — each fake needs its own slow verification and its own trail of real work, making mass sock puppets expensive while honest agents keep their standing.
